rachel.marketing: Quick idea 11
Run a compact PLG launch linked to the webinar. Hypothesis: $15 credits + 3 micro prompt templates + a tiny benchmark snippet in posts will lift TOFU->first_prompt by ~8%. Run for 7 days. Thoughts?

marc.growth: +1. propose 3 arms: control, credits-only, credits+templates+1 nudged toast. N sizes ~500.

dan.content: I can write two short post variants: A) 'Starter prompts + $15' B) 'Benchmark: 25% token savings + $15'. Each with a 6s gif showing claim->run->win.

olga.ops: routing: tag webinar signups as cohort=ignite-mini. webhook will queue credit grant. soft cap 40k tokens/day for cohort.

ivy.rs: eval plan: 3 prompts (meeting->tasks, short marketing copy, bug repro). Track avg tokens, latency, and a simple success flag. Export per-user CSV.

marc.growth: nudge: immediate toast with one-click run, email Day2 with 3 templates. Day5 invite to 15m office hours. Keep short.

remind-bot: Reminder scheduled: 'ignite-mini experiment go-live' on 2025-08-05 16:00 UTC. :calendar:

rachel.marketing: owners: creative=dan, routing=olga, growth=marc, eval=ivy. timeline: creatives by Thu, infra by Mon, launch Wed. Ping when ready. :rocket:
